user.title: Tuya Heat Pump Setup
user.description:
Enter your Tuya IoT Platform credentials and select connection type

• Cloud: Recommended for most users, works over the internet
• Local: Faster response, no API limits, requires device on local network

For MQTT (instant updates, optional): find the User Code in your Tuya app under Me → Settings → Account and Security → User Code and enter it below. How well this works varies by device — some devices get everything instantly, others are limited by Tuya's own restrictions (the integration automatically falls back to regular polling in that case). Leave it blank to skip this step entirely — everything else works exactly the same either way.

data_description.user_code: Found in the Tuya app under Me → Settings → Account and Security → User Code. If provided, you'll be asked to scan a QR code after this step to try instant (MQTT push) updates. Note: how well this works varies by device — some devices get everything instantly, others are limited by Tuya's own restrictions (in that case the integration automatically keeps using regular polling instead, nothing breaks).

local.title: Local Device Setup
local.description:
Enter local device details

Note: Device must be on the same local network as Home Assistant

After this, you'll also be asked about an optional climate (thermostat) card for this device — it's off by default, feel free to skip it.

Lower values = faster updates but more API calls

After this, you'll also be asked about an optional climate (thermostat) card for this device — it's off by default, feel free to skip it.

cloud_qr.title: Scan to Enable Instant Updates
cloud_qr.description:
Step 1: Open the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app on your phone → tap + in the top right corner → Scan → scan the QR code shown below.

Step 2: Once the app confirms it worked, come back here and click Submit.

Note: how well this works varies by device — some devices get all their data instantly, others are limited by Tuya's own restrictions and only get partial updates this way. Either way, the integration automatically falls back to regular polling for anything MQTT can't cover, so nothing breaks. If the QR code expires before you scan it, just click Submit to get a new one.

climate_options.title: Optional: Climate (Thermostat) Card
climate_options.description:
Completely optional and OFF by default — most models here are pool heat pumps where the temperature being controlled is the water, not the room, and on some models Tuya's own app already runs its own room-temperature control internally. Only turn this on if you actually want a Home Assistant thermostat card for this device, and you don't already have a separate physical/hardware thermostat or app-side control doing the same job.

Power (required): the switch the card turns on/off.
Current/Target temperature (optional): pick your device's own fields if it has them, otherwise leave blank.
Mode select (optional): only if your device can both heat AND cool via a mode field — pick it to get a Cool option too (you'll be asked which of its values means heat/cool next).

Tolerance, minimum cycle, min/max temperature: only used when your device has NO settable target temperature above — in that case the card manages the power switch itself (like Home Assistant's own Generic Thermostat), and these protect the compressor from short-cycling. Ignored otherwise.

Everything here is pre-filled with a suggestion where your device's own data makes one obvious, but every field stays editable, and you can revisit all of this later from the integration's own Options.

data.climate_target_temp_code: Target temperature (optional — use it if your device has one, otherwise leave blank)
data.climate_mode_select_code: Mode select (optional — only if your device can also cool)
data.climate_tolerance: Tolerance (only used without a target temperature above)
data.climate_min_cycle_minutes: Minimum on/off cycle duration, minutes (compressor protection; only used without a target temperature above)
data.climate_min_temp: Minimum target temperature (only used without a target temperature above)
data.climate_max_temp: Maximum target temperature (only used without a target temperature above)

climate_mode_values.title: Climate Card: Heat/Cool Values
climate_mode_values.description: You picked a mode-select field above. Confirm which of its own values means Heat and which means Cool — a suggestion is pre-filled where a value obviously matches, but double-check it against your device.

error.qr_not_confirmed: QR code not scanned/confirmed yet in the app — try again, or scan it now if you haven't
error.qr_request_failed: Could not request a QR code from Tuya. Check your User Code and try again.

confirm.description:

Step 2: Once the app confirms it worked, come back here and click Submit.
